title: Grateful Dead Live at Palace Theater on 1972-09-23
source: Recording Info: SBD > MR > C > DAT > CDR > SHN; Transfer Info: SHN > WAV > Sound Forge 10 > TLH > FLAC; Sonically enhanced, remastered, retracked upgrade of shnid 2201; Mastered and tracked by Bill Guarneri, July 25, 2014

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording of decent quality captures a spirited show with standout Bird Song and Big River performances.
ai_review.review: The concert is praised for its energetic delivery, especially the beloved Bird Song and what one reviewer calls the greatest rendition of Big River. While the soundboard source provides a clear listen, a few listeners note uneven moments that make this gig feel slightly weaker than other shows from the same period.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviewers are generally positive about specific songs and overall vibe, but mixed comments about consistency keep the rating just below four stars.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No explicit complaints; reviewers imply a clear, listenable capture typical of soundboard sources.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set is described as played with gusto and energy, though a few weak spots are noted that make it feel less cohesive than other shows from the same two‑week run.
